Required: name. Optional: category, city, capacity, minGuests, priceLow, priceHigh, pricing, tags, sourceUrl, notes, availableDates. Separate tags with |. Categories: venue, catering, photography, other. Pricing: flat, person, hour.

Built in the open.

Gatherlist turns venue research into a structured shortlist: source → review → match → share. Inspired by Greg Isenberg’s niche-matching business approach, adapted for small gatherings in San Diego.

This version was built with Codex on October 20, 2026. Matching uses visible rules, not an AI ranking. Text extraction is local and needs review. There is no automated social scraping, supplier outreach or booking.

Your listings are stored in this browser. Export them for backup. The research starter uses official public pages checked October 20, 2026; it does not establish prices, quality or availability. Fictional demo data is separate.
